text:
maria: kicked off a quick cross-region sweep comparing A100 vs H100 for Mistral-7B (q8x4 vs int8) — measuring prefill p50/p95, decode p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens. posting initial notes + logs :mag:

maria: command we used (nomad job + bench harness):
```
./bench/run_sweep.sh --model mistral-7b --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1,asia-northeast-1 \
  --skus a100,h100 --quant q8x4,int8 --prefill 512 --decode 1024 --qps 10 --duration 10m
```

maria: quick summary (high level):
- H100 wins on decode throughput ~1.6x tokens/sec for int8 in eu/us.
- A100 is competitive on prefill latency at small batch sizes, sometimes lower p95 on short sequences.
- q8x4 reduces cost but increases p95 tail on H100 in asia region (seen kernel fallback spikes).
- overall $/1M tokens: H100-int8 ~ $8.2, A100-int8 ~ $10.6, H100-q8x4 ~ $5.7 (ballpark).

jin: can you paste the p95 numbers? curious about tail behavior for cold starts.

maria: p95 decode (int8, 1024 tokens decode, region eu): H100 210ms, A100 340ms. prefill p95 (512 tokens): H100 120ms, A100 110ms.

alex: interesting that prefill p95 is lower on A100 — think kernel selection + smaller warmup seq helps. did you force same kernel policy?

maria: we used default kernel autodetect. noticed a few `kernel_fallback` warnings in logs on H100 in asia:
```
[2026-03-18T12:34:01Z] benchbot: kernel_fallback: fallback to generic matmul for layer 7 on h100-1 (reason: no optimized kernel for q8x4 seq=512)
```

benchbot: uploaded charts -> https://console.redwood.ai/bench/2615001234/chart (contains tokens/sec, p50/p95, cost curves, and kernel-fallback events) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: spotted a cluster of fallback events around 12:15 in asia — could be thermal throttling or driver mismatch. ops-bot, did any node reboots occur?

ops-bot: no reboots between 12:00-12:30 UTC. we had a driver update staged earlier this week (NVIDIA 535.xx), some hosts still on 530.xx in asia-n1.

jin: good call — mixed driver versions can trigger kernel mismatches on H100. if we homogenize drivers + rebuild kernels, q8x4 tail should improve. also try forcing `kernel_policy=prefer_optimized` in the runtime for a repeat.

maria: next steps I'm going to:
- re-run asia sweep after upgrading drivers to 535 everywhere,
- force kernel policy and compare,
- add cold-start measurements (0->1 replica) and 5/10/20 QPS mixes,
- collect KV cache hit rates and per-token latency histogram.

alex: can you also capture p99 for decode? sometimes p95 hides rare 1/10k spikes that matter.

maria: will do. planning to run another 6h sweep overnight and post results in morning. thanks all :rocket:
